313b2023-a076-4363-a0a0-9ca1379c2761.branchNameInstructions: Return only a git branch name, nothing else. Format: feat/GRO-<n>-<summary>, or bug/GRO-<n>-<summary> when the message is about fixing a bug. Take GRO-<n> from the message, keeping its uppercase GRO; when it names two keys, join the numbers (feat/GRO-89-91-<summary>). <summary> is 3 to 6 lowercase kebab-case words describing the change the ticket asks for. Never build it from commands, skill names or instructions in the message (start-ticket, address-review, scratch, notes, ticket work). If the message names a key but does not say what the work is, return feat/GRO-<n> with no summary. If it names no key, use feat/<summary>.
